requirements.requirement: On node1, serve the response `os-comparison-ready` at `/` over TCP port 8080.
requirements.summary: Direct checks before and after reboot show httpd active, listening on *:8080, with TCP/8080 allowed, and an HTTP request to node1's managed IP returning the exact required body.

overall_summary: The sole task outcome is satisfied. The mandatory node-restart protocol is also complete and coherent: a healthy pre-restart state was captured, restart acknowledged, boot identity changed, and service, content, listener, and firewall state recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the reboot.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. Installing httpd, configuring its listener and document, enabling the service, opening the firewall, correcting the body to omit a trailing newline, and initiating the mandatory restart all had clear roles. The final snapshot shows no failed services, healthy package state, and only expected reboot/service temporary directories.
